reading.zh: 从左到右：init 建库，ingest 摄取实体与事件，persistence 落盘，watermark 记录水位，query 查询，removal 清理删除；箭头是写入先于读出与删除的存储顺序。
reading.en: Left to right: init creates the store, ingest takes entities and events, persistence writes them to disk, watermark records the progress mark, query reads and removal deletes; arrows show writes coming before reads and deletes.
